text:
rafa-sales: Customer (CarePlus) wants a 6-day POC. Requirement: all inference and model pulls must remain inside their AWS account. They run an inline TLS proxy that rewrites SNI. Need a one-paragraph runbook + copy/paste allowlist + short note on route priority we can give them.

noah-net: noah-net: Short runbook: use PrivateLink interface endpoints for control-plane (HTTPS/TCP443 to ENIs) + run our agent in a customer subnet that pulls model artifacts from their S3 via an IAM role we assume. That avoids internet egress. If SNI is rewritten and can't be disabled, the fully isolated option is a Dedicated in-VPC deployment (enterprise).

anya-security: anya-security: Security items to include: request customer to exempt our CNs from TLS interception (*.redwood-inference.com and control-plane.<region>.privatelink.redwood.ai) OR add an exception for the PrivateLink ENI CIDRs. Ask for an IAM role ARN for S3 read access: arn:aws:iam::[ACCOUNT]:role/redwood-poc-s3-read. Attach SOC2 summary and KMS integration note.

jules-sre: jules-sre: Paste-ready allowlist (replace CIDRs/IPs with values we supply):
```
# Redwood POC allowlist (example)
TCP 443 10.60.120.0/24   # PrivateLink ENI block
TCP 443 34.210.11.22     # optional explicit endpoint IP
TCP 443 sts.amazonaws.com # role assumption
UDP/TCP 53 10.0.1.2      # onprem resolver
```
Routing blurb to paste into change ticket: "Make PrivateLink ENI prefixes more specific than any corporate proxy route. Add route(s) for <eni-prefix>/32 or /24 -> local ENI so VPC-local traffic to the endpoint does not follow the internet proxy."

noah-net: noah-net: Note on split-tunnel VPNs: ensure the ENI CIDRs route via the VPC attachment, not the tunnel default. For VPC peering alternative, both route tables must accept the pcx entry and security groups must allow cross-account traffic.

anya-security: anya-security: If they cannot exempt TLS rewrite, recommend an isolated subnet that bypasses the proxy for the POC (requires change control) or the Dedicated in-VPC offering. I'll draft the questionnaire answers.

jules-sre: jules-sre: Pricing ask: give them a dev POC line item (6 days) and note that Dedicated in-VPC is an enterprise upsell with licensing + SRE kickoff. Sales-ops will provide numbers.

netbot: netbot: Created ticket NET-2024-1135 "CarePlus POC network/security review" and scheduled call 2024-07-11 10:00 PDT.

rafa-sales: rafa-sales: Thanks team — I'll send the allowlist, route blurb, and ask them to confirm the S3 role ARN. :thumbsup:
